description.text:
The second expansion after Base Set, released on 10 October 1999 with 62 cards, the fewest of any main set for some time, in 11-card booster packs and two theme decks, Body Guard and LockDown. With Base Set and Jungle it completed the original 150 Pokémon: Articuno and Moltres came to English here, Ditto had its first card, and Mysterious Fossil, a Trainer with HP, plays as a Pokémon.

The Japanese Mystery of the Fossils (June 1997) had 48 cards and Mew; Wizards of the Coast held Mew back for a Pokémon League promo and printed 15 holos both holo and non-holo. Fossil came in 1st Edition and unlimited, and years later collectors found a third print with a 1999-2000 copyright line. It covers the non-holo cards only; the one holo with that date, Zapdos, came in a theme deck.

description.text: The unlimited Fossil holo, with its 1999 copyright, in cosmos holofoil instead of the Galaxy Star foil of the released English cards; cosmos foil only reached English cards with Base Set 2 in 2000. How these left Wizards of the Coast has never been documented, but every known copy traces back to the Seattle area, where Wizards was based, and the collectors who first showed them, some with all 15 Fossil holos, say they got them from former Wizards employees. Collectors believe they were a test of the new foil. Unlike most test prints, they are cut like ordinary factory cards.
